msg: rule sheet for pydantic 1→2 from cache (348 rules)

diagnosis: The upgrade to pydantic 2.x breaks because BaseSettings was moved to the separate pydantic-settings package, causing import errors in both test files. Additionally, the library code uses several deprecated V1 APIs: __fields__ (now model_fields), parse_obj_as (replaced by TypeAdapter.validate_python), and alias behavior has changed.

steps.change: replace `from pydantic import BaseSettings, SecretStr, ValidationError, parse_obj_as` with `from pydantic import SecretStr, ValidationError; from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings; from pydantic.type_adapter import TypeAdapter`
steps.why: BaseSettings moved to pydantic-settings; parse_obj_as replaced by TypeAdapter.validate_python

steps.change: update alias usage at line 321 to handle None return: `alias = field.alias; if alias is not None: d[alias] = vault_val`
steps.why: V2 alias returns None when not set, not the field name

steps.change: replace `from pydantic import BaseSettings, SecretStr` with `from pydantic import SecretStr; from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings`
steps.why: test imports BaseSettings which moved to pydantic-settings

steps.change: replace `from pydantic import BaseModel, BaseSettings, Field, SecretStr` with `from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, SecretStr; from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings`
steps.why: test imports BaseSettings which moved to pydantic-settings

risks: BaseSettings in pydantic-settings may have different default validation behavior (env_file_encoding, case_sensitive)
Optional field handling changed to match dataclasses (R46) - required vs nullable logic may differ
Union validation preserves input type by default (R45) - may affect type coercion
Regex engine switched to Rust crate (R47) - pattern behavior may differ for complex regex
